body:
FIX ROUND 1 (OPENING) (B-COPY2-123, agent 123) — growth-project-backend#756 @ ac907a09083879b3ad5c4ef45a54f8461b018458

F10: public pages copy round 2, the four Cs left by #755 (ops report B-COPY-123). Copy only; no logic change.

Fixed
- C-3 /terms intro: removed "They are written as a company policy draft, and counsel review is recommended." (`src/public-pages/trust-pages.html.ts` termsContent). Policy-page footnotes unchanged (pinned by trust-pages.spec.ts:395-410).
- C-2 /download/ios and /download/android: no "private review" and no notify-list promise. Body now "The iPhone app is not on the App Store yet. It can be downloaded there once the listing is live. For questions in the meantime, contact support." (Android: Google Play). CTA "Contact support" (`public-pages.html.ts` pageFor).
- C-1 /signup with a code: no first person, no manual-setup promise. Body: "Open The Growth Project app on your phone and enter the invite code below during setup to connect with your coach. If your coach shared a link, open it on your phone to launch the app. For help with setup, contact support and include the code." CTA "Contact support"; mailto subject still "Invite <code>".
- C-4 docs/help/faq.md and docs/help/support-boundaries.md: thirty-day soft-delete window replaced by the real 14-day cancellable grace period (`DELETION_GRACE_DAYS` default 14, `src/account-deletion/account-deletion.service.ts:172-175`), word for word with the rendered /help/faq and /help/support, which already said 14.

Tests: 4 new assertions fail on main src and pass here (public-pages 2, trust-pages 1, help-delete-account 1). Local, one file at a time: public-pages 14/14, trust-pages 48/48, help-delete-account 16/16, support-email.guard 7/7, help-pages 21/21; eslint clean on changed files.

CI at this head: all green except two checks that are red on main e9b82e13 too, unrelated to this diff:
- build-and-test: 1 failure, test/booking-lock-screen-push.spec.ts ("tomorrow" vs "today" in the 24h reminder line; clock-dependent), same failure on main (https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37494141389/job/112374203140). Here: 874 suites passed, 1 failed (https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37496448128/job/112382103458).
- npm audit: new critical advisory GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv on shell-quote 1.10.0 (dev-only, via @flydotio/dockerfile), same on main (https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37494141350/job/112374203384). No lockfile change in this PR.

Size: 7 files, 119 changed lines. No clinic partner named.

READY FOR AUDIT
